heat.inspect.title: Inspect
heat.inspect.showCameraTitle: Show where the camera is and which way it looks, top left of the view. {key} copies it.
heat.inspect.pickOnClickTitle: A click on the view (not a drag) shows the data point under the pointer, or else the spot on the level, with its coordinates. While the ruler is on, clicks go to the ruler.
heat.inspect.conventionTitle: Which yaw is shown and typed; set in the View panel
heat.inspect.convention.viewerTitle: The viewer's own: 0° looks along -Z, growing towards -X
heat.inspect.convention.gameTitle: The capture tools' and the game's: 0° looks along +X, growing towards -Z. Viewer yaw = game yaw - 90°.
heat.inspect.dataFrameTitle: Coordinates are in the loaded data's own frame: its axis mapping (up axis, flips, scale) is undone, so they match the source table.
heat.inspect.copyCameraTitle: Copy the camera's position, yaw and pitch as one line the jump box reads back ({key})
heat.inspect.hideCameraTitle: Hide the camera position (switch it back on in the View panel)
heat.inspect.goToTitle: Type or paste a point to look at, or a whole pose to stand in ({key})
heat.inspect.scanning: Searching the drawn data points under the pointer.
heat.inspect.indexing: Preparing the level for picking: {percent}%. The click is answered when it is ready.
heat.inspect.approximateTitle: Guessed from the parts' bounding boxes: this part of the level was simplified on loading, so its triangles no longer say which part they came from.
heat.inspect.copyPickTitle: Copy every value shown, and the coordinates as x, y, z
heat.inspect.lookAtTitle: Keep the heading and back off to a distance that shows this point and its surroundings
heat.inspect.standRowLookTitle: Put the camera on this data point, looking the way it looked
heat.inspect.standRowTitle: Put the camera on this data point, keeping the camera's direction
heat.inspect.standSurfaceTitle: Put the camera {height} m above this spot, keeping its direction
heat.inspect.jump.title: Go to a point
heat.inspect.jump.pointTitle: x, y, z or x y z, with a decimal point or a decimal comma. Five numbers, or a pose copied from the camera readout, set the yaw and pitch as well.
heat.inspect.jump.lookAtTitle: Look at the point from a sensible distance, keeping the heading (or the yaw and pitch given)
heat.inspect.jump.standHereTitle: Put the camera on the point, turned to the yaw and pitch given (or as it is)
heat.inspect.jump.empty: Type a point first: x, y, z.
heat.inspect.jump.unreadable: Not readable as a point. Use x, y, z or x y z, e.g. -321.6, 137.8, -59.9 or -321,6 137,8 -59,9.
heat.inspect.jump.badAngle: Yaw and pitch must be numbers, in degrees.
heat.inspect.jump.hint: Coordinates are world coordinates, the same as the readout and the pose above. {key} opens a box for this over the view.
heat.inspect.jump.hintDataFrame: Coordinates are in the loaded data's own frame, as in its table - the same as the readout and the pose above. {key} opens a box for this over the view.
